Sanskrit and Tamil, Grantha and Vatṭe-juttu. Issued from Kalakkuđi. States that while king Varaguna, son of Śrimāra-Srivallabha, who was devoted to god Śiva, was ruling, two villages, Tirumaṅgalam and Śomāśikurichchi clubbed together into one were granted by the king (Parāntakaṇ-Viranārāyaṇaṇ) to several Brāhmanas at the instance of Nārāyaṇaṇ-Kēśavaṇ, a learned Brāhmana of Tirumaṅgalam. States also that Kađungōṇ, a predecessor of the king, who uprooted the Kalappālar had granted the former of the two villages to 12 Brāhmanas and the latter to Kāthaka-sōmayājin and that subsequently the latter village was occupied by Kađattirukkai-kilavaṇ. Cf. Tamil text published in Tamil Polil, Vol. XXXV p. 13.

cells.location: BOMBAY / NANDED DISTRICT / DEOLUR TALUK · BOMBAY—contd. / NANDED DISTRICT—contd. / DEOLUR TALUK—contd. / Érgi (Khurd)—concld. — Maharashtra

Also records a grant of money from out of the customs accrued from twenty-two towns for Sandhivigrahī (name not given) and supply of flowers on specified occasions by the flower-vendors.

Also records a gift of money at the rate of a dramma and nisha per village from twenty-four towns to the guru Sōmēśvara in the presence of the preceptor (guru) Chandrarāśi to god Siddhēśvara. In characters of about the 12th century. See No. 184 below. Published in EP. Ind., Vol. XXXV, pp. 159 ff.

Mention is made of Chandra-sēkharamuni and Jñānēšayōgiśvara, the latter of whom seems to have constructed a temple and established some satras. In characters of about the 12th century. See No. 182.

The donation was made to the god Sōmanātha and the goddesses Jinarasa, and Jinasēna to meet the expenses of the mahāgajatiķāsthāna [of the temple of] Sōmēśvara at Karadikal.

cells.remarks: . Gives the genealogy of the Chālukya family upto Trailōkyamalla and introduces a subordinate chief, Danđanāyaka Nāgavarma of the Vāji family, whose genealogy also is given. Nāgavarma is credited with the victory over Malla, the lord of the Vindhya and the Sēvuna chief. Also records a grant of a house grown and land for service to the same community by Danḍanāyaka Nāgavarma, the prabhus of Taḍakal and the mahājanas of the place. Do.

cells.remarks: Records a gift of land, after purchase, by the generals Appaṇa and Goppana for some provisions, details lost. At the beginning of the record the 53rd day of the year is mentioned. Do.

cells.date: Śaka 852, Vikṛita, Vaiśākha śuddha 4, Friday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Refers to the death of some persons in a cattle raid. Mentions Mahāsāmanta Mahāyārasa of the Brahma-kshatra-kula and Mittūra-vamśa and his subordinate Pergade Arivarma.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Aralikatti † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone No. 5 in the same place
cells.date: Śaka 852, Vikṛita, Vaiśākha śuddha 4, Friday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the death of Mānamma, son of Vīra-Puli, during a raid on the village. In characters of the 10th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Bhairavanāpāda — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone set up near the Bhaidava temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Mahādhipati Gōvindara as governing Banavāsi-nāḍu and refers to Eṛo-Chōra.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Bhairavanāpāda † — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti stone lying near the same temple
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that two women, wives of Pāleya-nāyaka and Singana, committed satī, their husband having been killed in some encounter.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Bhairavanāpāda † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another māsti stone lying in front of the Māruti temple.
cells.date: Do. The week-day, do. is lost.
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: Do. Records that Abe Nāgati, wife of Vōbēya-nāyaka committed satī.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Bhōgāvi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Kalléśvara temple outside the village.
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: Badly worn out. Mentions god Sōmanātha of Abalūr and Saṭisige-70. Also records the construction of a temple and installation of a liṅga called Rāmēśvara therein by Ēkāntada Rāmayya and the gift of certain taxes, land, oil-mills and shops to it by several individuals. In characters of about the 11th-12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Chapparadahaḷi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of Hanumantadēva temple, about a mile to the north of the village.
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: States that (the land) is the mānya of Mukhyaprāṇadēva (i.e. Hanuman) of Chapara, obviously the village Chapparadahali. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Chapparadahaḷi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up behind the same temple
cells.date: Śaka 1187, Krōdhi, ans, Chaitra śu. ... Thursday.
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land, garden and houses by Vithala-daṇṇāyaka, the twelve Gauuḍas and the 12 Hettijabius to the god Śrīdharَśvara of Elanhalli included in the Raṭṭahaḷi division of Banavāsi-12,000. The gift was made in the presence of Mārụjivdēva.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Chaṭṭanahalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Basavaṇṇa temple.
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: . Badly damaged and worn out. Only the imprecatory portion can be made out. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUR TALUK · Chaṭṭanahalli † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.language: Durmati, Kārttikā ba. 10, Monday. Probably=1381 A.D., November 11.
cells.remarks: Lover portion damaged. Records a gift of land to god Bhaira-vadēva installed by Mādanaika. The name of the donor is lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · MYSORE—contd. / DHARWAR DISTRICT—contd. / HIREKHUR TALUK—contd. — Karnataka
cells.place: Chinmulugund.—Hero-stone set up near the Hanumenta temple.
cells.remarks: Worn out. Mentions Bayira-nāyaka. Purport not clear.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Māsti stone near the same temple
cells.date: Saka 1441, Māgha śu. 12, Monday, =1520 A.D., January 30, f.d.t. *50.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Records that a certain woman committed satī on her husband's death. Mentions Mulugunda situated in Ro(ṭṭa)hāji-vājya.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Sculptured ston in front of the Basavaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Sōmabou, wife of Beḷi-seṭṭi and disciple of Bhavasēnādēva of Mūla-sangha and Dēva-gapa. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone lying by the side of the masjid
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved. Registers a gift of land as umbaḷi to the mosque. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone built into the right wall of the Kalēśvara temple.
cells.date: . Year 4, Durmati, Māgha śu. 2, Thursday, Amāvāsyā, solar eclipse, saṅkrānti. Probably=1142 A.D., January 1.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of income from taxes like paṇḍāya and biraṇaga at Muguda for burning a lamp in the temple of Svayambhū Sōmanātha at Muguda. It states that Aṇmavēi, who was in charge of some taxes under Mahāpradhāna Heggade-dēyōpādhyāya Rēcharasa, the governor of Banavāsi-12,000.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone built into the left side wall of the same temple.
cells.date: . Chālukya Vikrama 47, Subhakrīt, Chaitra Amāvāsyā, Sunday, solar eclipse. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of an oil-mill free from biḷkōde tax for burning lamps in the temple of Sādēśvara by Daṇḍanāyaka Mallarasa who was administering Tiruvāvaṇūr, a disciple of Rudramayya, wrote the record, and Sāvōja, son of Bōmanuja of Hiriya-keroṇūr engraved it.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Chimmulgund † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up inside the Chilkkēśvara temple outside the village.
cells.date: Siddhārthin, Kārtika śu. 11, Wednesday. Probably=1319 A. D., October 24, f.d.t. '70.
cells.remarks: Seems to record some grants in favour of the god Chikka-nātha, probably by Chaṇḍa-bhūpāla, son of Bomma. Mentions Hima-muni, disciple of Mēghasūri. In charac-ters of the 14th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Hajjir — Karnataka
cells.place: Top of a slab bearing the image of Maruti lying outside the village on the way to Puradakēri.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Purport not clear.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Hajjir † — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken slab set up in the same place
cells.remarks: Fragmentary The record contains a genealogical account of the Sindas of Belagavati) who was an antahpurâdhyaksha, gajahadhyaksha, etc., and the heyday of Banavâsi-nâdu. All other details are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Hirekerûr — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar behind the Tôtada Virappa temple.
cells.date: Saka 881, Siddhârthi, Vaiśâkha śu. 5, Thursday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: States that the pillar was erected by Kahari Mâramsingayya who performed a gômēdha. The figure of a plough-share is cut in relief on the face of the pillar. Cf. No. B 86 of A. R., Ep., 1951-52.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the house of Râshṭrakūṭa Dodḍabasappaṇavara Siveppa.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of income from tax on ghee to (the goddess) Mâribba of Kachhavi by Mahâsâmantadhipati Mâraiya who was governing Banavâsi-12,000. It mentions Appâvintêi as the senior wife and Kattiyara as the son of the chief. In characters of about the 8th century. Published in Progress Reports of the Kannada Research Institute, 1953-57, p. 65, No. 1.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken hero-stone near the Local Board well.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Only portions of the improvisory part can be made out. In characters of about the 8th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone set up below the banyan tree near the Giapappa temple.
cells.remarks: . States that four gauđas whose names are mentioned, obtained the Gauđike of the village Kachavi from [Hazarath] Sāhib by paying a nazar of 2160 (rupees).

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another stone in the same place
cells.remarks: States that it is the village (pura) of god Sômanâtha of Huligere. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone bearing the image of Ganapati in the same place.
cells.remarks: States that the image was got done by Sanki-gauṇḍi and Nâgapa. In characters of about the 16th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kachavi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone set up in the land belonging to Erangaṇauḍa Basavaṇagouda Pâțil.
cells.remarks: States that the nadha was created for god Bhikshâvarti- Basavaligadēva by the sthânika, desâyis, nadgauḍas, gauḍa sēnabôga and other devotees. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Kanavi Shidgêri — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the Châlukya of Kalyâṇa Jayasimha Siddhesvara temple on the Siddappanagudda about a mile from the village.
cells.remarks: Lower portion damaged. Records a gift of land, house-site and oil-mill to [samadagi] Râmêsvara-deva at Eluvalli by Mahâmandalēśvara Pâṇḍyadevarsa and his subordinate Kumâra Chauṇḍa. The record contains a preamble praising the family who is said to have belonged to the Kadamba family. The gift was entrusted to Bhaṭōśaktidēva, the sthânapati of the temple. The composer of the record was Boppa, and Nêmoja engraved it. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Khaṇḍâbâgât — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up beside the border temple of Durgavva on the border of the village Râmatîrtha.
cells.date: Šaka 846, Tāraṇa, Pushya, ba. 6, Monday, Uttarā, [Sōbhana]- yōga =924 A.D., December 20.
cells.remarks: Partly damaged. Seems to record a gift of land by Sômarâsi. Mentions mahâ-sâmantâdhipati Sâṅkaragaṇḍa who was governing Banavâsi-12,000. Mentions Sûriyarayaguru (Śûriyarâja), dēva and others, and the village Bâgûr situated in Edēveta- 70. Published in Progress Reports of the Kannada Research Institute, 1953-57, p. 76, No. 14.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKHUR TALUK · Khaṇḍâbâgât † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of panṇasa. States that Eroyama was administering the was. In characters of about the 9th century. Ibid., p. 71, No. 8.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · MYSORE—contd. / DHARWAR DISTRICT—contd. / HIREKERUB TALUK—contd. — Karnataka
cells.place: Kirgēri.—Fragments of a hero-stone set up against the wall at the entrance of the village, facing the river Tunga-bhadrā.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 15, Pramōdūta, Mārggaśira śu. 1, Sunday, solar eclipse=1090 A.D., November 24, f.d.t.'16.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seem to record the death of an individual in fight. Mention a nāyaka whose name is not clear. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in front of the Rēvaṇa-Siddhēśvara temple.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 15, Pramōdūta, Mārggaśira śu. 1, Sunday, solar eclipse=1090 A.D., November 24, f.d.t.'16.
cells.remarks: Worn out. Records gifts of lands, garden and oil-mill to the gods Svayambhu-Sōmanātha and others. The gifts were entrusted to Nārāyaṇēva and Narasimadēva, sons of Madi-gauḍa, and to Kōṭisvara-gurava of Kōḍamaggi. A portion of the lands granted was given to the priestess of the temple. Singamayya wrote the record and Kōḍoya of Abbalur engraved it.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab set up in the same place
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year 1, Pingala... Thursday, Dakshi-pāyana-saṭhkrānti. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Lower portion peeled off. Refers to a Mahāpradhāna Mahā-sāmantādhipati Daṇḍanāyaka whose name is lost. Mentions Eḍeveṭṭa-70 division. All other details are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hēro-stone set up in the same place
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Records the death of Sāvanta Kālēya along with another nāyaka (name not clear) in a fight at Kōḍamagge. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the temple of Bayala Basavappa beside the field of Khāṇōji Kālāl.
cells.date: Saka 1080, Bahudhānya, Kārtika amāvāsī, Sōmavāra, lunar eclipse. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged and worn out. Records gifts of land and money probably to a temple by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Īśvara-dēva. Mentions certain chiefs and his subordinate. The gift was made over to Kalyāṇasaktipaṇḍita. It refers to Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara (Nammīya Gaṅga Permāḍidēva) as governing Eḍeveṭṭe-70 division. Seems to contain an account of the Sinda family. Other details are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Hēro-stone lying in the same place
cells.date: Regnal year..., Ḍhātuni, Vaiśākha śu. ba 10, Monday= 1217 A.D., May 1, f.d.t.·26.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that when Vīra Ballāladēva attacked Polalālvūr to plunder it, nāyaka Naṅgēya, who was a servant of Mahāmāṇḍalēśvara-daṇḍanāyaka Bommiḍidēva and who was governing Belagavatti, fought in the battle and died.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the field of Saṅkarappa Hoggeri near the same temple.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to god Amrītēśvaradēva on the occasion of Vijayadaśamī by the Crōdēśvarī, twelve kittus and arvaṭṭokku tuṇḍu, headed by Adhikāri Sīdharasa. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Kōḍamaggi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the field of Gurunāthappa Dīkshita near Mantr-Kōḍamaggi bridge.
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved. Seems to record a gift of money by Rāmēkalarya. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone standing in the shrine of Īśvara within the temple of Basavappa.
cells.date: Śaka 1185 (wrong for 1186), Rākta-kshi, Chaitra su. 10 (?), Sunday = 1294 A. D., March 5.
cells.remarks: Records when Sihgeyab-danāyaka, the Mahāpradhāna of the Hoysala kingdom, raided Hanjūr in the Edavetta country and drove away the cattle. Nālagrabhu śāsana Kālagaunda's battle, disciple (?) of Mūrūjiśādēva, attacked Bīmarasa, brother-in-law of Ereyanga, the Hoysala (?), and died in the fight that ensued after freeing the cattle. The record states that Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Kumāra Bommi-dēvarasa was administering the country from his capital at Hosagunda.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Two pieces of a slab lying in front of another Īśvara shrine within the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 967, Pārthiva, Mā gha śu. 5, Sunday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land and garden to god Mākālēśvaradēva at Kūgalūr by Bamma-dēvarasa (?) by Mahāmānya Bījarasa. The gift was made over to yogi Bhōgiśi-jiōa. One mattar of land was also granted to the stone-mason Gavare. Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chāvuṇḍaraya-rasa was governing Banavāsi-12000. Chāvuṇḍaraya wrote the record.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of the same shrine
cells.remarks: Right side built in and broken at the bottom. Records a gift of paddy and income from taxes made for feeding ascetics and repairs to the temple of god Mākālēśvara of Mēgavu by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Mā... of the Sinda (?) family who was administering Banavāsi... and other areas when Mahā-pradhāna Daṇḍanāyaka Gōvindarasa was governing the vāsi-12000 and Sāntalige-1000 divisions. The gift was made over to Lakulīśvara-paṇḍita. Also registers further gifts of income from taxes by other officers whose name are given.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Two pieces of a slab built into the compound wall on the backside of the same temple.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 38, Nandana, Pushya ba. 10, Thursday. Uttarāyaṇa-saṁkrānti. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records a gift to the temple of god Mākālēśvara of Mēgavu built by Mākālēśvaragunda, after worshipping the feet of Agni-bhaṭāraka. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chāvuṇḍa-rāyarasa as governing Banavāsi-12000, and Mahāsāmantādhipati as subordinate to him, Ereyanga Rātapaḷḷi-70 and Mūgunda-12. Refers to a certain Ayyana of the Sinda (?) family and some geographical divisions like Mēdūr-12 and Kundūr-12. Details of gift are lost. Cf. No. 576 above.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment of a slab lying in the dilapidated house of Koritagēri Vrappa.
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift. Details are all lost. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab bearing a nāga image, in the house of Sri D. B. Kulkarni.
cells.remarks: In late characters. Purport not clear. In characters of about the 8th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the field of Basappa Gubbara
cells.remarks: Damaged. Contains the figure of a boar on the top. Records a gift of land on the basis of Mallave (?) by Rājādityarasa of the Saluki (Chālukya) family who was governing Banavāsi-12000. The gift was made over to a preceptor (name lost) who was the disciple of Mōni-guruva. Kirugudda engraved the record while [Mādora] wrote it. Published in Progress Report of the Kannada Research Institute, 1962-67, pp. 70-71, No. 7.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUB TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Two pieces of a slab in the same place

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · MYSORE—contd. / DHARWAR DISTRICT—contd. / HIREKERUE TALUK—contd. / Mēdūr—concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Broken piece of a slab in the same place
cells.remarks: Contains the epithets Prithviivallabha, etc., and the figure of a horse on the top. In characters of about the 8th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Mēdūr † — Karnataka
cells.place: Sculptured slab lying on the road to the east of the village.
cells.date: Śaka 13[81], Saumya, Kārtika śu. 2, Monday, Irregulars.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land to god Brahmadēva by the projē of Mēdūr. Hanumayya wrote the record.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Nāgavanda — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the outer wall of Siddhēśvara temple.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 53, Kālaka, Mārggaśīrsa, lunar eclipse, Iroguāru.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of income from handra[*]-laṇa (tax) for burning a perpetual lamp in front of god Brahmēśvara of Nāgārjjuna situated in Edēveṭṭu-70, Būrva, who was a subordinate of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara sōma of the sēnabōga belonging to the vaṁśa and who was governing Edēveṭṭu-70, [Maṇahē]rē-12 and a division of fifty-six (villages).

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Nāgavanda † — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar set up outside the same temple, below a mango tree.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama 45, [Sārvva]ri, Kārttika Amāvāsyā, solar eclipse, Sunday. Probably =1120 A. D., October 24.
cells.remarks: Records that Bāchiga who was a servant of the god (dēvara baṇaja) ended his life at Nāgārjjuna on the day of the eclipse and his preceptor Nāgarāśinapaṇḍita had the pillar set up in his memory.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Nāgavanda † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone lying outside the same temple
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Seems to record the death of a person. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Nāgavanda † — Karnataka
cells.place: Lamp-post set up in front of the Hanumanta temple.
cells.remarks: Mentions Raiṭṭalli. Records the setting up of the lamp-post in front of the Hanumanta temple. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Niḍangēli — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up by the side of the Kallēśvara temple in the old village.
cells.date: Šaka 1095, Nandana, Uttarāyapa saṭ-krānti, Amāvāsyā, solar eclipse. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of income from several taxes for the worship and offerings in and repairs to the temple of Mallikārjjuna at Niḍangēli by [the] Mahā-Vihāra-svāmi Niḍangēliya, with the permission of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Chōlikēya Kētadēva, who was the Daṇḍanāyaka of Banavāsi-nāḍu and Daṇḍanādyaka Kartya Mahādēvarādva Gyāhindarasa who was in charge of the Hejjumma and Vaddarāvula taxes.

cells.location: MYSORE / DHARWAR DISTRICT / HIREKERUE TALUK · Niḍangēli † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.date: Śaka 1087, Paushya, Uttarāyana samkrānti lunar eclipse. Irregular.

(2) Sarvajit, Chaitra pupnami, Vishu-santkramana, Monday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: . Records that Kāma-gāvunda, son of Kētisetṭi had the temple of Rāmēśvara built at Emmanūr situated in Nāgarakranda of Banavāse-nādu, and donated a garden and land to the same on the first date. On the same day the Five hundred (mahājanas) of the place and also Mallibōva-danđanāyaka, an officer in charge of the taxes donated the income from the taxes. In the next year, Vibhava, Kāmagāvunda having passed away, his son Rēcha-gāvunda renewed the same gifts and entrusted them into the hands of Atṭa-hāsa-muni of the Pāśupata school on the second date. The inscribed slab was set up by Masaṇi-setṭi, son of Jakki-setṭi. At the time of the second date Sōvidēva of the Kadamba family was governing the Banavase country. Cf. M.A.R., 1928, p. 77, No. 79.

cells.remarks: Records the erection of the veikēla (memorial pillar) of Lōka-chandradēva belonging to Mūla-saṁgha, Sarasvati-gachchha, Balatkāra-gaṇa and Kuṇḍakuṇḍa-nvaya. Refers to the son of Mahādēva-śrēshṭhi. The concluding portion of the epigraph is damaged.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Mentions Koṇḍakuṇḍ-[ānvaya] and Mahāchadēva. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to refer to the death of a person named Chaṇḍa. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Reads (1) Ananta Muḍgala (2) Rāmatirtha [l*] Śrī-astu [l*]. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Kannaḍa .

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Śaka 1312, Pramōdūta, Dhanus, Pādya, Thursday=1390 A.D., December 8.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Registers gifts of rice by some individuals and a grant of money by Pāṇḍyappa-vodeya for a perpetual lamp. In characters of about the 15th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kembhāvī † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Damaged and worn out. Registers a gift of paddy and money by Kommarasi, wife of Rāma-sēnabōva, and her daughter-in-law Bommarasi and Chikkia-Śaṅkaramma, the wife of Narasappa-sēnabōva.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kōnappalli — Karnataka
cells.place: Hero-stone lying beside the railway line outside the village.
cells.remarks: Refers to the death of a person in a fight. In characters of about the 10th century. Cf. Mys. Arch. Rep., 1924, p. 46, No. 45.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Kōnappalli † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another hero-stone lying in the same place
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the setting up of a stone by Sanamaraḍan in the place where his father Muttaraśan, son of Adittan-māran had died. Records a gift of land to a hero, called Gāṇḍarāditya-rāsan, an ancestor of the hero is described as the tilaka of the Jayasvamia family. In characters of about the 11th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Siḍlaghaṭṭa — Karnataka
cells.place: Two faces of the pillar in front of the Mārutī temple.
cells.king: Tirumala †
cells.remarks: Indifferently engraved. Refers to the erection of a lamp-post. The king, Tirumala of Bhaṇḍa and Tiruveṅgaḷanā-tha, Timma engraved the record. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Siḍlaghaṭṭa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Śrīnivāsapur Taluk

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Alavaṭṭa — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in the Varadarāja temple.
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to refer to a cattle raid. In characters of about the 9th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Alavaṭṭa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Stone set up below the tank bund
cells.remarks: Records a gift of biṭṭukaṭe by the king. In characters of about the 10th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Alavaṭṭa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Base of the liṅga in a ruined temple near the tank.
cells.remarks: Badly damaged. Commences with the praśasti, Pugaḷmāḍu viḷanga, etc. Seems to record a grant to some deity.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up near the Baṅgāraḍa Basavaṇṇa temple.
cells.date: [Chāḷukya-Vikrama year 20, Yuva, Pushya ba. 11, Mon-day, Uttarāyaṇa-saṅkrānti=1095 A.D., December 24, f.d.t.·42.]
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by Sarvakraṭu Eroyane-bhaṭṭōpā-dhyāya Sōmayāji to the gods Vishṇudēva, Rāmēśvaradēva and another (name lost). The donor had received this land as agrahāra (two villages) as sarvamānya from the recipients of the village Huvinaḥaḷu and Kaḷmaṭe from the king. It re-states that the village Gōbhūr was given by Āhavamalla to the mahājanas as dakshiṇā at the time of the performance of kōṭi-hōma.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab, second side
cells.date: [Chāḷukya-Vikrama year 20, Yuva, Śrāvaṇa śu. 5, Fri-day=1095 August 8.]
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Mentions Kramaḍa Malladēva-bhaṭṭa and refers to some grants, details of which are lost.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up near the temple of Basavanna.
cells.date: Year 4, Durnati, Āshāḍha śu. 7, Thursday-1141 A.D., June 12.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by Vaishnava Mahāchāryapana for the worship and offerings to god Kesavadeva in his temple. The grant land was purchased from Vaishnava Kandarpabhatta. Another grant of land situated to the west of Kadambaramallavada was made for the installation of the deity by the mahājanas of Hiriya-Gobbur. Similar grants made by different individuals to the same god are also recorded.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built horizontally into the wall of the old chāvadi.
cells.date: Year 7, Raktākshi, Srāvaṇa śu. 5, Friday-1144 A.D., July 7.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of paddy levied on different articles of merchandise by the Malleśvara-Anuvatakōlu and Billa-Three- Hundred for the worship of the god Nāgabhūshana on the Kanakagiri to the west of Piriya-Brahmagari, Sareanamasadagradāra Hiriya-Gobbura.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the temple of Mēlasankara
cells.date: Year 8, Subhānu, Phālguna ba. 5, Friday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: Gives the descriptive account of Gobbur (also called Gopuragrāma), its mahājanas, in glowing terms in verse. Records a grant of money, collected at the rate levied on every kuniega-māli by the měl-sāsirvaru for worship and offerings to god Mahālinga Mēśēvara installed by them.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment of a stone set up in the masonry of the well in front of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of money to the god Mēleśvara installed by the Měl-sāsirvaru kasāya-nakara, Narasinga-nayaka and others of Gobbur. Records also a grant of two flower-trees by the Malleśvara temple priest, for the same god. The inscription was written by Mallideva, son of Rāmādeva.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab leaning against the left wall of the same temple.
cells.date: Year [3], Śrīmukha, Vaiśākha śu. 7, Friday=1153 A.D., April 3.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records some gifts for the worship of the god Mahālinga-deva at Gobbur by various individuals. Also records some other grants to Keśavadeva by other officials and individuals.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab
cells.date: Year [5], Bhāva, Phālguna ba. 1, Saturday-1155 A.D., February 19, f.d.t.·23.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of taxes on loads carried on the backs of oxen, bisons and donkeys, for the worship and offerings to the god Keśavadeva (whose temple was situated) to the north of the god Mahālinga (temple) at Gobbur. A lower portion of the plate recording the grant was also issued. Gāṇada Kātisetty and the five hundred Svāmis were entrusted with the work of executing the grant. Similar grants for the worship of the god as well as for the feeding of the pūjāri by the nādu also recorded.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the ruined temple called the Bukkīṇṇavara-guḍi.
cells.date: Chālukya-Vikrama year ..., Jyēshṭha Amāvāsyā, Sunday, solar eclipse.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land made by Ādityabhaṭṭa-sōmayāji, after purchasing it from [Palkā]va, to the gods Keśavadeva, Harihara, Gaṇapati, Sūrya and Mahēśvara.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying on the bank of the pond behind the same temple.
cells.date: Dhātri, Bhādrapada ba. 11, Friday=1216 A.D., September 9.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of four mattar of land in Ingujahalī by the mummuri-dandas of Hiriya-Gobbūr. The grant land was entrusted to the Two Hundred (mahājanas) of Mosalikallu. The purpose of the grant is not specified.

cells.location: MYSORE / GULBARGA DISTRICT / CHINCHOLI TALUK · Gabbar † — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar in the right corner of the Veṅkaṭēsvara temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1136 (current), Śrīmukha, Vaiśākha Amāvāsyā, solar eclipse=1213 A.D., April 22, Monday. The month was Pūrṇimānta.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to a number of Brāhmaṇas of Gōpuragrāma by Jīvarāja bhaṭṭa of the lineage of Lakulīśa, under a subordinate officer under the king. Also records similar grants of land by the donors Sonn Manu bhaṭṭōpādhyāya Sōmayāji, Sanka bhaṭṭōpādhyāya Sōmayāji and Śrīpatibhaṭṭōpādhyāya Sōmayāji.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / DEVADURU TALUK · MYSORE-contd / RAICHUR DISTRICT-contd / DEVADURU TALUK-contd / Gabbūr-concld — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up on the bank of the well in front of the Bāla-Hanumān temple.
cells.remarks: Only a portion of the praśasti is preserved.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / DEVADURU TALUK · MYSORE-contd / RAICHUR DISTRICT-contd / DEVADURU TALUK-contd / Gabbūr-concld † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up near the same well
cells.remarks: Seems to record some gift, details not clear. In characters of about the 14th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying on the roadside near the Gaṇapati temple.
cells.remarks: Mentions a Vīra-Veṅkaṭa-Mahārāyalu who had the titles Rājādhirāja and Rājaparamēśvara.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the house of Veṅkaṭaramaṇarājulu.
cells.remarks: Mentions Tirumalarāyalu who is also given the same titles as above.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.remarks: Badly worn out. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja and Timmarāja and seems to record a grant by the latter for the merit of the former.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the platform behind the temple of Raṅganātha.
cells.remarks: Do. Mentions Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Rāmarāja. The details of the grant are completely worn out.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab built into the wall of the Jain temple
cells.date: Chitrabhānu, Vaiśākha, śu. 3, Monday=1342 A.D., April 8.
cells.remarks: Partly broken. Records the construction of a chaityālaya by Irigan-daṇḍanāyaka, a general of Harihara, probably at the instance of the latter. The name of the city in which it was built is lost but it is stated to be situated in Kuṇṭala-vishaya in Karṇāṭa-maṇḍala. A genealogy of the Jaina teachers is given.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Pillar in the Chintāmaṇi Āśrama
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Only a part of the first two lines are preserved.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Boulder in the river opposite to the same Āśrama.
cells.remarks: Records the death by Samyaktva-vrata of Kāḷuhāyi, wife of Pradhāna Buddhāraya. In characters of about the 13th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab in the banana grove outside the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1358, Naḷa, Phālguna śu. 1, Tuesday=1437 A.D., February 6, f.d.t. .33.
cells.remarks: In cursive script. Records the construction of the temple of Bhairavadēva.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.place: Boulder on the bank of the river near the ferry.
cells.remarks: Seems to state that Kampa-bhūpa (son of Harihara) had a path made to the Tuṅgabhadrā.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.date: Śaka 1478, Ânanda, Chaitra śu. 1, Thursday=1556 A.D., March 12 †
cells.remarks: Another boulder in the same place

cells.remarks: LINGSUGUR TALUK Bhōgāpur.—Boulder called the Narasinagunđu, about a mile away from the village.

cells.remarks: Gauđūr.—Slab lying in the bed of the stream about a mile away from the village.

cells.remarks: Slab lying near a well called Ūra-bhāvi

cells.remarks: Slab built into the floor of the Dattātrēya temple, about a mile away from the village.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Slab bearing the sculpture of Hanumān

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka

cells.king: Jagadēkamalla [Jayasimha II] †
cells.date: (1) Śaka 938, Nala, Uttirâyana-saṁkrâ-nti-1016 A.D., December 23, Sun-day=f.d.t.·14. (2) Śaka 940, Bahu-dhânya, Pausha su. 11, Friday, Uttarâyana saṁkrâ-nti. †
cells.remarks: Jāvūr.—Slab set up near the Rāmalinga temple.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka

cells.remarks: Kamaladinni.—Two sides of a pillar lying near the Išvara temple.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / GANGAVATI TALUK · GANGAVATI TALUK Anegondi † — Karnataka
cells.remarks: Two other sides of the same pillar

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · MYSORE—contd. / RAICHUR DISTRICT—contd. / LINGSUGUA TALUK—contd. / Kamaladinni—concld. — Karnataka
cells.place: Two fragments of a slab in the compound of Lakkamma temple.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land made to the Lakṣmī temple, probably by a certain Ōba-nāyaka. Mudugal-sime is mentioned.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Kōḷa — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying in front of the temple of Hanumān.
cells.remarks: States that the Gāṇāchāryas and the Jōgamas of the samaya of god Pārvatadēva were entitled to certain privileges on occasions of marriages, etc., in the Kuraba of Hālumata of the 35 villages included in Kōḷi-sime.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Kōḷa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Another slab in the same place
cells.date: Śaka 1475, Pramādi, Āśvija śu. 10, M., Monday=1553 A.D., October 2.
cells.remarks: Records the exemption of certain taxes on barbers of the 35 villages included in the Mēdhavisayana-kōṭe.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Kōḷa † — Karnataka
cells.place: A third slab in the same place.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Aliya Rāmappadēva and another and seems to refer to a grant by the king.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Kōḷa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Fragment of a hero-stone on the fort-wall
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Kōḷa † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying outside the temple of Rāma-liṅga about a mile to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and broken. Records a grant probably of money, to a god (name lost) by a subordinate (name lost) of the king.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Līṅgasugūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab on the road-side leading to Guḍadāḷi.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land situated in Karađikal, to the Kāśi-matha enjoining that the income (from the land) was to be enjoyed by Hoñchina-ođeya, a resident of Karađikal.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Māchnūr — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the compound of the Nārāyaṇa temple.
cells.remarks: Worn out. The imprecatory portion is preserved. The inscription was written by Sōmadēva-paṇḍita and was engraved by Mallōja, son of Chaṇḍōja, of Karaḍikal.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Maraĵi — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up in the temple of Hanumān.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of the village Chikka-Marali, situated in the sīmā of Tāvaregere, to the maṭha of the saint Karaḍiyaliṅga disciple of the saint. The grant was made on the occasion of the amāvāsyā. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Mudgal — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying near the bījī bāvi inside the fort.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Mentions Auraṅgajeb Ālamgīr, Rāma-siha and Rāṇavat, Kaḷādāra and Faujadāra. Refers to Rāma-buruj. For the Persian version see App. D, No. 126.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Mudgal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Boulder in the maddā dāḍi inside the fort
cells.remarks: Reads (1) Veṅgaḷapa-nāyakaru (2) ka[p]aṭa [ko]ḷajavu. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Mudgal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Fort wall in the same place
cells.remarks: States that the person who built the buruj was Malika Murūda. In late characters.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK — Karnataka
cells.place: A raised platform in the same place

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Mudgal † — Karnataka
cells.place: Similar platform by the side of the above
cells.remarks: Purport not clear. Do.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Navali — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab lying behind the Jajātān-kara temple.
cells.remarks: Purport not clear. Seems to mention Viramadēvaji.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Sultānpur † — Karnataka
cells.date: Šaka [91]36, Ānanda, Vaiśākha šu. 3, Monday=1014 A.D., April 5.
cells.remarks: States that the rājaguru of Jayasimha having died on Kārttika ba. 8, Monday, Paridhāvin (1012 A.D. November 10) at Navile, Jōgašivāchārya of Karađikal endowed a piece of land purchased from Māpikēšvara-bhaļāra and others, for the worship of the pādukās of the deceased saint. Navile is described as a tīrtha-sthāna. Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXIV, pp. 164 ff.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Navali † — Karnataka
cells.place: Slab set up to the right of the same temple.
cells.date: Chāḷukya Vikrama 44, Vikāri, Kārtika śu. 13, Thursday. Irregular.
cells.remarks: States that Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Bhūtarasa of the Kaḍamba family installed a god (name not clear) at the gate of Jayaśaṅkaradeva of Navale, installed the god Traipuṟēśvara on the bank of the Krishṇā and made a grant of the village Karāḍal-300 for worship and offerings in the temple. He also made a gift of land to the Śaṅgati and three others who were looking after the temple.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Navali † — Karnataka
cells.place: Same slab .
cells.date: Bhūlōkamalla 10, Rākshasa, Chaitra šu. 5, Thursday =1135 A.D., March 21.
cells.remarks: States that Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Madhavāṅkēyarasa installed the deity Jaṭāsaṅgava near (the temple) of Trailokyeśvara and the grant of Muttagę formerly endowed by his father Bhūtarasa (see No. 711 above) and also made a grant of land to a ācārya, and pādukās to the Brāhmaṇas and the nivēśi[la]s (caretakers?) of the temple.

cells.location: MYSORE / RAICHUR DISTRICT / LINGSUGUA TALUK · Navali † — Karnataka
cells.place: Upper panel of the same slab

cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Begins with an adoration to guru Hiravijaya-sūri. Mentions Bhāramalla who received the governorship of many villages from the Pātaśāha's subordinate Tōdaramalla and Bhāramalla's son Indrarāja who received the governorship of Vaṭraṭa-draṭga and his brother Ajayarāja. Indrarāja built the temple of Vimalanātha called Mahōdaya-prāṣada and also Indra-vihāra and installed many images including those of Pārśvanātha, Chandraprabha and Rishabhadēva bearing the names of his father, himself and his brother respectively. Akbar is mentioned as worshipped by the fourteen Chhatrapatis and numerous Maṇdalādhipatis and also apparently as the lord of the maṇdalas of Kaśmira, Kāmarūpa, .. tāna (probably Mūlatāna), Kābila (Kabul), Badakaśī (Badakshān), Dhilli, Marusthali, Gurjjaratrā, Mālava, etc. The record described as Indra-vihāra-prāṣada-praṣasti, was composed by Pañ. (i.e. Paṇḍita) Lābhavijaya-gaṇi and was written on the stone by Pañ. Sōmakuṣala-gaṇi. Also mentions Mahōpādhyāya Kalyānavijaya-gaṇi. Probably engraved by Musarapha, Bhagarū and Mahamadāla, sons of Bhairava. Cf. Bhandarkar's List, No. 810; PRAS, W.C., 1909-10 p. 45.
